title: Cadia 地下金銅礦
summary: 以panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水解析Cadia 地下金銅礦：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Cadia underground gold/copper mine through panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 公開資源工程的離線質量、能量及環境證據判讀；不提供鑽井、井控、採掘、爆破或危險化學浸出SOP。採礦權、許可、地質完整性與現場規範需由合格團隊另行確認，課程完成不是操作資格。
scopeEn: Offline public resource-engineering material/energy/environmental analysis; no drilling, well-control, excavation, blasting or hazardous-leaching SOP. Qualified teams separately establish rights, permits, integrity and field requirements; completion is not operating qualification.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Cadia 地下金銅礦案例中比較地下grade與取樣與panel caving物料路徑，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate underground grades/sampling and panel-caving material paths within the Cadia underground gold/copper mine case.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Resources, grade and representative sampling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對地下grade與取樣提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable resources, grade and representative sampling model and evidence record for underground grades/sampling.
steps.instruction: 在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識地下grade與取樣。品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 建立資源品位與代表採樣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify underground grades/sampling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.
steps.check: 提交地下grade與取樣的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for underground grades/sampling.

knowledge.title: 資源品位與代表採樣
knowledge.text: 品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 本課架構對應：地下grade與取樣
knowledge.textEn: Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Course architecture correspondence: Underground grades/sampling

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設乾給料1000 t、品位1.7 g/t、金屬回收率0.85，可回收金屬=1445.0 g=1.4450 kg。回收率不同於精礦品位；未含礦物解離、處理成本或任何浸出配方，非礦場實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume dry feed 1000 t, grade 1.7 g/t and metal recovery 0.85: recovered metal 1445.0 g=1.4450 kg. Recovery differs from concentrate grade; liberation/costs and all leaching recipes are excluded; this is not a mine measurement.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的「資源品位與代表採樣：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出材料來源、試件幾何、加工歷史、品質與回收流的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「材料生命線：去向要可追溯」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試片編號、方向、淨截面、熱歷史與回收質量帳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Resources, grade and representative sampling: architecture analysis” in “Cadia underground gold/copper mine”. Draw the material source, specimen geometry, process history, quality and recovery-stream boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Material Lifelines: Trace Every Stream” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen ID, orientation, net section, thermal history and recovery mass account, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 就地下grade與取樣的「資源品位與代表採樣」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for resources, grade and representative sampling in underground grades/sampling?
options: 品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。
最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate.
The best sample represents every ore parcel.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
quiz.explanationEn: Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Resources, grade and representative sampling: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對地下grade與取樣提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable resources, grade and representative sampling model and evidence record for underground grades/sampling.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「資源品位與代表採樣」模型，檢查地下grade與取樣的兩個假想案例。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous resources, grade and representative sampling model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving underground grades/sampling. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.
steps.check: 提交地下grade與取樣的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for underground grades/sampling.

steps.title: 開坑地下與搬運：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Open-pit, underground and haulage: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對panel caving物料路徑提出可反駁的開坑地下與搬運模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable open-pit, underground and haulage model and evidence record for panel-caving material paths.
steps.instruction: 在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識panel caving物料路徑。露天、地下與重力砂金路徑的邊界不同；搬運與支撐影響能量和風險。 建立開坑地下與搬運的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify panel-caving material paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of open-pit, underground and haulage, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。
steps.observationEn: Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：露天與地下可沿用所有支護和搬運參數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Surface and underground systems share every support/haulage parameter.
steps.check: 提交panel caving物料路徑的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for panel-caving material paths.

quiz.question: 就panel caving物料路徑的「開坑地下與搬運」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for open-pit, underground and haulage in panel-caving material paths?
options: 露天與地下可沿用所有支護和搬運參數。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
露天、地下與重力砂金路徑的邊界不同；搬運與支撐影響能量和風險。
optionsEn: Surface and underground systems share every support/haulage parameter.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks.
quiz.explanation: 露天、地下與重力砂金路徑的邊界不同；搬運與支撐影響能量和風險。 畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths.
